svg.title: Four optimizers on the Rosenbrock function, computed with numopt
svg.desc: Four optimizers on the Rosenbrock function from x₀ = (−1.2, 1). Each run stops at the first iterate with ‖∇f(xₖ)‖₂ ≤ 10⁻⁸, within a 20,000-iteration budget: Newton converges in 6 iterations; BFGS converges in 38 iterations; Heavy-ball momentum converges in 4,128 iterations; Gradient descent (Armijo backtracking) converges in 15,231 iterations. Right: f(xₖ) − f⋆ against k on log–log axes; Newton's curve bends down (quadratic), BFGS's bends down later (superlinear), the first-order methods fall on straight lines (linear).
